name: End of the African Humid Period (drying of the Sahara)
summary: Period when the monsoon weakened and the green, lake-dotted Sahara turned to desert. Researchers disagree on whether the change was abrupt or gradual.

claims.note: Abrupt end of the humid period about 5,500 years ago (deMenocal et al. 2000).
Gradual drying, with the modern desert in place by about 2,700 years ago (Kröpelin et al. 2008, Lake Yoa, Chad).
